attributes.residual: CAPPED region -- the 5 angles sites at Player+0xC4/+0xC8 in PlayerMotion (2 `(f32*)((u8*)p + 0xC4)` CreateYPRMatrix arguments, 3 `PF(p, 0xC8, f32)` heading stores). Three distinct source forms were tried and ALL produced the byte-identical regression real 3778 -> 3823 (+45 insns): (1) `p->angles` array decay + `p->angles[1]`; (2) scalar site only as `p->angles[1]`, pointer site left raw; (3) header re-declared as three plain scalars angles_0C4/0C8/0CC with `p->angles_0C8`, no indexing anywhere. The identical delta across an indexed and a non-indexed form rules out index-addressing and points at the shared base: the target materializes p+0xC4 ONCE and reaches the heading store at +4 off that same register, because the store and the CreateYPRMatrix argument sit adjacent in the source; any member spelling gives each site its own base, and the --ops diff shows the cost as extra lis/addi/stw address materialization in PlayerMotion's entry region (T[13:23]@34-5c). DO NOT RETRY member-form conversion at Player+0xC4/+0xC8 in pmotion.c without a genuinely new idea about preserving that shared base. The field name angles[3] is retained in the header regardless -- the layout is proven, only the local spelling is capped -- with the cause recorded in the header comment.
